name: Tourist / Visit Visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing sufficient funds for the visit and return journey.

outcome.duration_length: 30, 60, or 90 days single or multiple entry; a 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa (self-sponsored, 90 days per visit, extendable 90 more) is also available to all nationalities

sources.title: Tourist visa - The Official Portal of the UAE Government

notes: Fees confirmed: 30-day tourist visa AED 252, 60-day AED 352 (both +5% VAT, +AED 10 each Knowledge/Innovation Dirham if applied for inside the country); extension fee AED 600 (+VAT). GCC nationals (Saudi, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar) enter visa-free with a 30-day stamp. Many Western/developed-country passports get visa-free or visa-on-arrival access; a broader 'other nationalities' group gets a 30-day visa-on-arrival if holding a valid US/UK/EU/Australian/Canadian/NZ/Japanese/Singaporean/South Korean visa or residence permit — Indians with such a qualifying visa/residence get a 14-day visa-on-arrival, extendable once for 14 more days. GENUINE 2026 EXPANSION confirmed: Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines, Kenya, and South Africa became eligible for visa-on-arrival (with a qualifying residence permit) from June 2026 — a real, dated expansion of visa-on-arrival eligibility worth flagging. Status adjustment to a work/residence route is possible in-country in many cases without leaving the UAE first — a genuine practical flexibility distinct from most other countries' visitor routes in this dataset, which typically require leaving to convert status.
